_doc: Tùng Đào Cung, part 3: Luyện Khí (outer gate, young inner disciples, a servant). World-depth pass, sect writer.

people.role: Outer disciple who hears more in the pines than the primer says
people.appearance: A skinny woodcutter's boy with sap on his sleeves who turns his head toward the trees in the middle of a sentence.
people.backstory: A woodcutter's son from Tiều Phu Thôn, he came to the outer gate in 1198 and could not learn the Listening Pine Primer by its words, only by its sound. He says the pines on the hill above Tùng Hạ Thị are saying something longer than the primer, and that it goes on past where the steward stops. Tuyên Bích Hà (tuyen_bich_ha) told the first elder. Nobody has yet told Thôi Khinh Hồng (thoi_khinh_hong), who has been listening for exactly that for five hundred years.
people.wants: To hear the pines say the whole of what they say, and to find someone who will write it down.
people.secret: He hums the pines' longer phrase to himself on the hill each night and has begun to hear it answered from further up; Kha Lâm Đông (kha_lam_dong) follows him and swears he hears nothing.

ties.note: the steward who noticed
from the same village
lends him a blanket
outer disciple from the woodcutters' village
chants the primer to the outer gate at Tùng Hạ Thị, line by line

people.role: Outer disciple from the lake
people.appearance: Wears a fish scale on one cheek like a beauty mark and has given up washing it off.
people.backstory: Lăng Ngư Đăng's (lang_ngu_dang) brother, a lamp-fisher's boy whose Wood is too thin for the inner gate; he spends her allowance on lake fish for the outer gate's kitchen.

ties.note: his elder sister

people.role: Outer disciple at the malachite mine
people.appearance: Keeps the low, slow miner's stoop even across open yards.
people.backstory: Cổ Lục Sơn's (co_luc_son) nephew from the mining village, all Metal and a little Wood; he will not pass the inner gate's test, and nobody has told him.

ties.note: his uncle and master
his cousin at Vạn Hác
outer disciple at the malachite mine

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall
people.appearance: A tiger-claw charm hangs at his neck, and he taps it whenever he says the word tiger.
people.backstory: Địch Kinh Lâm's (dich_kinh_lam) brother's grandson, who has never seen a tiger and tells everyone he will kill one. He claims he has seen a tiger; it was a dog.

ties.note: his great-uncle
the newest outer disciple, from Thanh Tùng Thôn

people.role: Ferry girl of the Đàm family
people.appearance: Freckled to the hairline, and calls out the fare before anyone has asked.
people.backstory: A ferry girl of the Đàm family of Cổ Độ who rows for her aunt Đàm Lưu Ba (dam_luu_ba) and means to be the second of the family to become head. For a month she charged a blind Cổ Độ net-mender double, until her aunt found out and made her pay it back from her own purse.

ties.note: her aunt and master
her brother; ferry boy of the Đàm family at Cổ Độ

people.role: Outer disciple of the River Hall
people.appearance: Long-jawed, blotchy, ears set too low; even his father's friends pat his shoulder and look elsewhere. He sniffs the air before rain, and is right.
people.backstory: Hoàng Đê Sinh's (hoang_de_sinh) son, who carries the flood-mark rod behind his father and counts the rain; the village children call him Muddy Jaw and he answers to it.

ties.note: his father and master
outer disciple of the River Hall; runs the sluice signals

people.role: Incense Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: Smells faintly of agarwood since birth; a pale censer-spark mark on one cheek.
people.backstory: Thi Mộc Hương's (thi_moc_huong) daughter, born smelling of agarwood, who lights the dusk stick when her mother's hands shake.

ties.note: her mother and master
young inner disciple of the Incense Hall

people.role: Inner disciple at the Tide Rite
people.appearance: Does not shiver at midwinter; salt crusts his eyebrows.
people.backstory: A coast boy who swims with the Tide Rite's two keepers every midwinter and does not seem to feel the cold. He swims out past the markers where the keepers turn back, the only boy who does.

ties.note: swims beside him

people.role: Pill Room sweeper
people.appearance: A broom taller than she is; she wipes her hands on her hair.
people.backstory: A herb girl who came north from Thính Vũ's Song Khê Thôn with a caravan, she sweeps the Pill Room and has learned forty recipes by heart from listening at the door. She keeps the jar for the Pill Room's scrap-pay and has twice let Cát Linh Thảo (cat_linh_thao) answer for a short count.

ties.note: young inner disciple of the Pill Room; stokes the chimney furnace

people.role: Outer disciple from the woodcutters' village
people.appearance: Answers every question a beat late, as though the words had to walk to him.
people.backstory: Trình Văn Thanh's (trinh_van_thanh) friend from Tiều Phu Thôn, who joined the outer gate because Văn Thanh did and is better at its chores than at its primer.

people.role: Woodcarver's apprentice
people.appearance: Wood shavings in her hair at supper, and in bed.
people.backstory: A girl of the Lâm woodcarvers of Lộc Minh, apprenticed to Lâm Điêu Bách (lam_dieu_bach) to learn which fallen pines can still become a beam.

ties.note: of the same clan, and her master
outer disciple; the woodcarver's second apprentice

people.role: Granary guard at Lâm Hạ Trấn
people.appearance: A nibbled crust always rides in his pocket; grain dust in his hair.
people.backstory: A farm boy from the Pivot's Mộc Hương Thôn who guards the granaries at Lâm Hạ Trấn (A073) and knows every mouse in them by name. He naps on watch and sells the spilled grain by the sack, so the widows who used to gather it find the floor clean, and Tề Tiểu Mạch (te_tieu_mach) took the beating for the open door.

ties.note: outer disciple; counts sacks at the granaries of Lâm Hạ Trấn

people.role: Outer disciple riding with the road wardens
people.appearance: Rides with the whip uncoiled across his saddle; a wolf-tooth charm at his throat.
people.backstory: A Bạch Lang boy who wears his village's wolf-tooth charm (A070) and rides the caravan roads with Vu Hành Lâm (vu_hanh_lam). He dragged a Bạch Lang boy of fourteen, caught with a stolen bell, behind his horse for a mile as a warning, and Vu Hành Lâm has stopped riding beside him.

ties.note: the Tuần Tùng warden he rides with

people.role: Outer disciple who was refused by Ngạo Tuyết Phái
people.appearance: Touches the plum-blossom scar on her forearm whenever she is angry.
people.backstory: From Hàn Mai Thôn below Ngạo Tuyết Phái, she wanted the plum sword, but Lăng Đạp Tuyết (lang_dap_tuyet) turned her away for want of Metal, and she has come to the pines to prove him wrong. She hid an iron sliver in her sleeve for the reading; the girl who sat beside her, who knew nothing, was put out with her.

ties.note: turned her away
the loose swordsman who spars with her at the market
the Ngạo Tuyết girl taken the winter she was turned away

people.role: Young inner disciple who tends the pines of the dead
people.appearance: A sapling cutting wrapped in damp cloth rides in his pack.
people.backstory: From Thanh Tùng Thôn, where a green pine stands for each of the dead of Hổ Khiếu (A058); every third spring he walks the ten weeks back to tend them, and Trịnh Ức Vân (trinh_uc_van), who understands, goes with him.

people.role: Inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall; the governor's descendant
people.appearance: Wears the clan-seal ring turned inward; stands as if a roll were being read over him.
people.backstory: A descendant of Giáp Tùng Chi (giap_tung_chi), the governor who died on the Cold Ford quay; the family left the coast in 905, named him 'the ford returns', and Nhiếp Vãn Đào (nhiep_van_dao) chose him for that. He reports each doubt she voices about the deserter roll to her grandfather.

ties.note: the governor
his aunt; keeps the Coiled Root Hall's roll of the Cold Ford families
his sister; outer disciple; the governor's descendant

people.role: Outer disciple at the Lake Hall
people.appearance: Towels over both shoulders, and a little steam always rising off her.
people.backstory: Born beside the hot spring of Noãn Ốc (A014), she carries towels to the old cultivators who come to soak their bones there and hears everything they say. She sells the old soakers their own towels back by the hour, and Phương Ngọc Sa (phuong_ngoc_sa) has been told the towels are free.

people.role: Outer disciple from the reindeer herders
people.appearance: Wears the antler-button coat everywhere, in the lowlands too.
people.backstory: A reindeer herder's son from Tuyết Lộc Thôn on the lake's north shore (A002), where Băng Tâm's fishers come every spring; he speaks their dialect and has two friends among them. He tells the Lake Hall he has none, and let Lăng Ngư Đăng (lang_ngu_dang) think she was the only one he trusted.

ties.note: his sister; outer disciple from the reindeer herders of Tuyết Lộc

people.role: Inner disciple in the resin trade
people.appearance: A pocket abacus on a cord, clicking as he walks.
people.backstory: A merchant's son from Thính Vũ's Xuân Thảo Thành, sent north at twelve, who learned the resin trade from Hầu Thiện Kế (hau_thien_ke), including the part his master does not show the steward. He skims a tenth of the good lots, and lets Tiết Vân Huân (tiet_van_huan), who splits the resin, take the blame for the thin ones.

people.role: New outer disciple from the river towns
people.appearance: Cannot stand still through a speech; a coin-sized hole is burned through his sleeve.
people.backstory: A river-town boy who found the coins of a forgotten city on the dry bed of Đông Lưu Thành in 1198 (A081) and spent them on the road to the outer gate. He sells the rest to pilgrims as a king's tomb-silver at double, and Lã Truyền Thanh (la_truyen_thanh) paid him a month's allowance for three.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Hall of Voices
people.appearance: Chews the end of her braid between sentences.
people.backstory: A Tùng Phong Thôn girl who grew up under Vạn Hác's zither students (A056) and is Ngô Tố Âm's (ngo_to_am) only disciple. She told the outer gate that the heir's zither hums at night, which she made up, and the Root Hall has questioned Ngô Tố Âm twice since.

ties.note: the Vạn Hác boy from her village
young inner disciple of the Hall of Voices

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Array Hall
people.appearance: A measuring rope round her waist like a belt.
people.backstory: A quarry girl from Lạc Thạch who carries the array stones Hồng Mặc Kỳ (hong_mac_ky) is too lazy to carry, and has started placing them better than he does.

ties.note: young inner disciple of the Array Hall

people.role: Stove boy of the palace kitchen (servant)
people.appearance: Something breaks within arm's reach of him most days: today a bowl, yesterday the ladle.
people.backstory: A Phượng Minh caravan cook's son left behind at Tùng Hạ Thị, he is the kitchen's stove boy, Fire-rooted in a sect that fears fire among its pines; he cooks for the outer gate and lends Trình Văn Thanh (trinh_van_thanh) his blanket.

ties.note: head cook of the palace kitchen (servant)

people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the palace kitchen: a Fire-Metal root the lineage cannot take (R2)

people.role: Hàm Nguyệt Trang's pledge at the Lake Hall
people.appearance: Gloved in midsummer; her fingertips frost the cup she holds.
people.backstory: Kiều Nguyệt Châu's (kieu_nguyet_chau) grand-niece, sent from Hàm Nguyệt Trang to the Lake Hall as a pledge of the manor's loyalty; she carries Ice in her root, which the pines cannot teach and Băng Tâm would.

ties.note: her great-aunt
her elder brother at the manor, who has no frost
outer disciple at the Lake Hall; dives for the pearl count
